propositions: Repository delegation must maintain a clear boundary between local multi-file persistence and selective tickets-branch publication without blurring ownership semantics.
Publication must stage only the five allowlisted bridge-state files and never publish repository checkpoints independently.
Unchanged passes must create no commit, and rotation/retired-first recovery must preserve existing publication and recovery floors.
Repository ownership and ordered partial-state behavior must be explicitly documented with rejection of journal, format-migration, deep-copy, and write-elision alternatives.
Selective-publication regression tests must prove the five-file allowlist, rotation semantics, and publication-vs-persistence split remain intact through S1 cutover.
ADR 0099 must record subsystem-scoped sole ownership, open-views-not-copies semantics, asymmetric dispositions, and rollback/compatibility constraints.
